title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2610.20607v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) is a cornerstone of autonomous robotic systems, yet real-world fine-tuning remains a formidable challenge because of high-dimensional action spaces and intricate coupling between heterogeneous modules. In this paper, we propose HiRe-MoMa (Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation), a systematic framework for stable and sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of complex MoMa systems. At its core, HiRe-MoMa adopts a Hierarchical Residual Architecture that fine-tunes a frozen base policy. A Policy-Agnostic Residual learns additive corrections atop the base policy, while Hierarchical Decoupling splits the residual into mobile-base and manipulator-arm heads with unidirectional conditioning, mitigating gradient interference and aligning corrections with the platform's physical hierarchy. translated_title: 基于稀疏人类引导的真实世界移动操作分层残差策略学习
translated_abstract: 移动操作是自主机器人系统的基石，然而由于高维动作空间和异构模块之间复杂的耦合关系，真实世界的微调仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了HiRe-MoMa（分层残差移动操作），这是一个用于复杂移动操作系统稳定且样本高效的真实世界微调的系统性框架。其核心是HiRe-MoMa采用分层残差架构来微调冻结的基础策略。策略无关残差在基础策略之上学习加性修正，而分层解耦将残差拆分为移动底盘和机械臂两个头部并采用单向条件化，从而缓解梯度干扰，并使修正与平台的物理层次结构保持一致。为了在数据昂贵的真实世界环境中提高样本效率，我们提出了专家引导的价值对齐，利用稀疏的人类引导（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HiRe-MoMa分层残差框架，通过对冻结基础策略进行移动底盘与机械臂解耦的残差修正，并结合稀疏人类引导的专家价值对齐，实现真实世界移动操作系统的稳定且样本高效的微调。
